label: GO step, late episode: about to choose a2 again after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only on GO steps (never D1/D2), and only when the agent picks a2 (model_act == 2, policy logit strongly favouring a2; 77% of mass in the most negative choice-logit bin). It needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (98% of mass has prev_reward == 0, near zero after a reward) and the previous choice to have been a2 too, so it is a stay-on-a2 after no reward. It also depends strongly on position in the episode: silent before about trial 40, rising to a peak at trials 80-89. Value is low-to-mid (5.2-7.1). It also fires on most D1-fixation-error GO steps (in_rew == -1). Magnitude grows over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials, often rare transitions to S1 while S2 is good: top windows show the activation climbing from 0.1 to 1.0 over 2-4 such trials. It does not fire on a1 choices, after rewarded trials, or early in episodes. Only observed variables and the agent own choice are used. Dev F1 0.68, mass recall 0.94. Precision is about 0.55, because many late-episode unrewarded a2 GO steps stay silent, mostly after a single isolated loss.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 u, ?, a2 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7, phase=GO & ep_dec=9.
